set.body:
Outcome

Reuse the proven one-shot operator kernels behind the common scientific compiler.

Acceptance

- Runwise readouts produce relations without beta-volume materialization.
- Fixed measurement legs compose before unnecessary readout work.
- Pair edge weights, orientation, and reducer are explicit.
- Direct query, sufficient-statistic, dense, and materialized paths have comparable receipts.
set.title: P4B.3: compile PairingDesign and MeasurementFrame into one-shot sufficient statistics
